newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks post modest gain, helped by Dow.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks post modest gain, helped by Dow.

text.p: Argentine stocks pushed timidly higher in late trading Friday, aided by a surprise rally in New York after strong U.S. jobs data, dealers said.
"Wall Street's unexpected sharp rebound from early losses has helped keep the bolsa steady," said one trader.
The blue-chip MerVal index rose 0.4 percent to 674.62 an hour before the close, pulling off a session low of 670.54 against a 672.17 opening.
Top main-tier gainers were Telefonica and Telecom, up 3.1 percent and 2.6 percent. Volume was strong at 20 million pesos.
